headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: HUL (4)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Singapore Grand Prix Sprint from pole position, 2.6s ahead of Lewis Hamilton, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Carlos Sainz made the biggest climb, from P22 to P12.
Oscar Piastri had a day to forget, dropping from P4 to P14.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.
There were 54 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 3 times.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 89 points over George Russell.
